data.disagreement_analysis: The apparent disagreement stems from a tool error in qwen3-235b (HTTP 400 API failure when auditing .SRCINFO), not from actual security concerns. This report carries no verdict signal per the rules. The only valid vote (deepseek-v4-flash) correctly identified the package as safe with thorough analysis of all files.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to audit .SRCINFO due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in inconclusive verdict
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should not produce inconclusive verdicts when all successfully reviewed files are safe; the tool should distinguish between 'could not complete audit' and 'found security issues'
When a single file fails to audit due to transient errors, the system could provide a verdict based on successfully reviewed files while flagging the coverage gap separately
Advisory reports from free-tier models can provide useful corroboration but should not be counted as votes per the rules
